leadText:
The Scarlet & Violet arc (Japanese: 第十六章　スカーレット・バイオレット編 The Sixteenth Chapter: Scarlet & Violet arc) is the sixteenth story arc of the Pokémon Adventures . It began serialization in August 2023.

The arc follows the adventures of two students at Uva Academy: Violet Lang, a self-proclaimed prince journeying to obtain the Herba Mystica in order to become the "Prince of Speed" with his , and , a professional treasure hunter searching for the treasures of ruin by the request of her client. Along the way, Violet gets roped into taking down a group of delinquent students known as Team Star, whom Scarlet also has some history with.
plainText:
The Scarlet & Violet arc (Japanese: 第十六章　スカーレット・バイオレット編 The Sixteenth Chapter: Scarlet & Violet arc) is the sixteenth story arc of the Pokémon Adventures . It began serialization in August 2023.

The arc follows the adventures of two students at Uva Academy: Violet Lang, a self-proclaimed prince journeying to obtain the Herba Mystica in order to become the "Prince of Speed" with his , and , a professional treasure hunter searching for the treasures of ruin by the request of her client. Along the way, Violet gets roped into taking down a group of delinquent students known as Team Star, whom Scarlet also has some history with.

== Terminology ==
 
This arc gets its name from the core series games, Pokémon Scarlet and Violet.

==Volumes==
===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
 
As with the four arcs before it, the Scarlet & Violet arc is being collected separately into mini-volumes. The first volume was released on February 28, 2024.

====United States====
 
An English translation of the Scarlet & Violet arc will be released by VIZ Media under the title Pokémon: Scarlet & Violet, which will be released in their own mini-volumes as with the four arcs before it. The first volume was released on February 11, 2025.

==Gym, Squad Boss, and Titan Battles==
===Gym Battles===
Scarlet and Violet defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Katy (PASV06; Scarlet)
Brassius (PASV09; Scarlet)
Iono (PASV13; Scarlet)
Larry (PASV20; Violet)

===Squad Bosses===
Scarlet and Violet defeats the following Squad Bosses:
Giacomo (PASV05; Violet)
Mela (PASV16; Violet)
Atticus (PASV23; Scarlet)

===Titans===
Scarlet and Violet defeat the following Titans:
Titan (PASV08; Violet)
Titan (PASV11; Violet)
Titan (PASV18; Scarlet and Violet)
Titan (PASV25; Violet)
Titan (PASV25; Violet)
Titan (Violet)

==Trivia==
This is the first story arc in which the female protagonist is named after the first game in the pair, as well as the first story arc in which the male protagonist is named after the second game in the pair.
This is the first media outside of the games in which Uva Academy is depicted.
This arc is currently the last to be published in paper format, as the series moved to the online website Weekly CoroCoro Comic starting with PASV19.
